_doc: SKEPTIC audit of the qal/recov gate-charge RECOVERY claim. Every number here is from a run made in this directory with PYMS_VAE_CACHE=.../vae_cache_skrecov built from scratch, extracted by ./sk.py (written from the netlists, independent of qal/recov/rv.py). Decks generated by ./gen.py, which prints every line it removed/added.

G1b_fresh_cache_rerun_of_the_claimed_bes.note: all differences are settled ~1e-7 V cell outputs

a_ledger_rerun.row: m1d_h5b580_adv6 (free-running 5-harmonic resonant gt/gtp taps, beat 580 ps, RS 25 ohm, gtp advanced 6 ps)

where_it_goes.path: no gt-gtp conductive path exists in the netlist; the gt tap's apparent recovery arrives through the nMOS gate-channel/overlap capacitance from the swinging sw and bkb nodes (Miller), i.e. it is harvested from the transfer node, not recycled from the gtp tap

ideal_PWL_control_same_topology.note: gt is a net receiver in the ideal control too -> topology property, NOT a waveform artifact. The round's claim reproduces.

transfer_not_degraded.note: bank A's actual expenditure is flat; the transfer is genuinely intact

b_recursion_audit_MEASURED.what_the_5.273_fJ_omits: the park pulse driver, the tap DC-bias supply, the resonant network's sustaining amplifier. The round books the park at Q_pk*VGH from an IDEAL PWL step.

park_driver_rail_energy_fJ.not_an_edge_artifact: a 0.5 ps and a 130 ps input edge give 15.48 and 15.02 fJ
park_driver_rail_energy_fJ.conservative_because: bare sg13_lv devices (sg13lv_compat.sp drops ad/as/pd/ps, so ZERO junction capacitance), minimum sg13g2_inv_1 geometry, free ideal input, and NO delay chain at all

tap_DC_bias_is_not_purely_reactive.implication: a free-running LC network cannot supply a net DC charge; a real bias supply is needed. Booked at the ideal sources' instantaneous voltage; if referenced to the 1.5 V rail instead the extra is up to 1.807 fC * 1.5 V = 2.71 fJ. BOUND, not measured.

sustaining_amplifier.recomputed_with_a_real_park: no efficiency clears the line once the park driver is real

VHI_1p5V_pMOS_bulk_rail_unbooked_anywher.note: grep finds no mention of EHI/VHI in any committed README or RESULTS. Pre-existing campaign omission, not M1-D's fault; the M1-D delta is immaterial, but 4.49 fJ/hop is 35% of the whole 12.75 fJ budget and currently has no home in either the hop or the timer ledger.

disagreements_both_in_the_conservative_d.m1a2_te133_r1000: round FAIL (50%-crossing order), mine PASS (device-referenced order). Round chose the stricter detector.
disagreements_both_in_the_conservative_d.m1d_h5b580_adv12: round FAIL on VBEND high side; at the PRE-REGISTERED checkpoint it PASSES (0.688340).

checkpoint_violation.pre_registered: tD = 811.755 ps, fixed absolute, 'regardless of deck tend'
checkpoint_violation.verdict: procedural violation, IMMATERIAL: every gate still passes at the pre-registered checkpoint. It does widen the claimed adv window (adv=12 passes).

park_charge_halving_error.why_wrong: the park source makes only ONE transition inside the 580 ps window, so halving the rectified integral halves a one-way charge
park_charge_halving_error.effect: +0.26 to +0.89 fJ, does not change any verdict

best_row_gates_at_the_pre_registered_che.cut_order_50pct: pMOS +3.9 ps LATE (allowance +5), park +14.0 ps after gt fall
best_row_gates_at_the_pre_registered_che.cut_order_device_referenced: pMOS +1.82 ps LATE, park +30.77 ps after the nMOS cut
best_row_gates_at_the_pre_registered_che.note: the shipped stdcell timer has the pMOS 20.6 ps EARLY; this row is on the wrong side of 'early-or-with' and passes only inside the 5 ps measurement allowance

reverse_current_at_the_cut.note: 1.5x the shipped design's reverse current; the transfer still completes (VA_open 0.0916, better than the committed 0.0978)

data_word_robustness.control: the SAME data words under the committed IDEAL-PWL drive
data_word_robustness.conclusion_1: the VBEND data swing is INHERENT to the bank, NOT an M1-D defect -- my first reading of this was wrong and is corrected here

M1D_specific_finding.note: a +-2-cell data change moves the ordering margin over 4.9 ps of the 5 ps pre-registered allowance, and the tuned gtp advance is a single fixed phase that cannot retune per word

eta_denominator_is_immaterial.note: all clear 71%; the denominator choice never decides anything

d_admission_recomputed.the_level_error: eta is a LOAD-referenced ratio (against Q_gate*VGH = 43.5 fJ); the threshold N_min = (39.6+E)/0.8309 needs a DRIVER-referenced energy. The pre-registration tied them with the identity 'conventional driver cost = load Q*V'. For the resonant gt/gtp taps that identity holds (the network IS the driver). For the park it does not, and the campaign's own as-built measurement puts the gap at 302.8 fJ of driver for 43.5 fJ of load charge = 7.0x.

e_verdict.confidence: high on the arithmetic and the park measurement; the one open door is a resonant park tap, which this round neither built nor measured
e_verdict.what_survives_from_the_round: the resonant gt/gtp pair itself: 2.974 fJ net, ledger closed to 1e-12, independently re-metered by a path that never touches the 1F instrument, transfer intact (EA_C -0.22%), all completeness gates PASS at the pre-registered checkpoint. That is a real result.
e_verdict.what_does_not: 5.273 fJ is not E_timer. It is the gate-node dissipation of two ideal-source taps plus an ideal-source booking of the park, and it omits the park's driver -- which alone, measured at its floor, costs 15.0-15.5 fJ against a 9.77 fJ headroom.
